title: Automated Creative Agency Project Triage
business: A boutique creative agency managing high-volume client feedback across multiple Trello boards.
problem: Project managers spend excessive time manually moving client requests from a centralized 'Inbox' board into specific project-based boards, leading to delayed responses and missed task assignments.
solution: The Trello connector for Claude allows the agency to automate the triage process by using natural language instructions to read cards from the central Inbox and write them to the appropriate project boards based on project metadata.
steps: Authenticate the Trello MCP server within the Claude interface to grant read/write access to the agency's workspace.
Instruct Claude to use the trelloReadInbox tool to retrieve all pending client requests from the central board.
Provide Claude with the mapping logic to identify the correct project board for each request based on card descriptions.
Execute the trelloWriteCard tool to recreate the card on the target project board and trelloWriteInbox to remove the original item.
outcome: Project managers achieve a streamlined workflow where client requests are automatically categorized and assigned without manual intervention, ensuring faster project turnaround.
limitation: The connector relies on Claude's ability to interpret card content accurately; if a card lacks sufficient detail, the automated triage may misclassify the task. Users must manually verify the board assignments in the Trello UI to ensure accuracy.
